verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs state that it contractually bars OpenAI and Anthropic from training on user data. Business and Enterprise plans add a Zero Data Retention agreement under which no AI interaction or console data is collected. However, the no-training commitment names only two providers, the stronger ZDR guarantee is limited to higher-tier plans, and there is no documented user-facing training opt-out. Missing for 10: a documented no-training guarantee covering Gemini and the open-source model providers, a ZDR or equivalent guarantee on Free and Pro plans, and independent verification of the no-training claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Warp does not allow OpenAI or Anthropic to use your data for model training.
Business and Enterprise plans are covered by our Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreement. No AI interaction or console data is ever collected.
